children: eClerx Services Ltd, a Mumbai-listed business process management firm, has acquired RegEdge, a US-based risk and regulatory consulting company, the company announced today.

RegEdge, founded in 2019, specialises in helping financial institutions manage compliance programs across trade and transaction reporting, surveillance, financial crime compliance, and regulatory change management.

The acquisition expands eClerx’s footprint in the financial services sector, where it already provides AI-powered analytics and digital operations to major institutions. RegEdge’s expertise in trade lifecycle risk and regulatory operations is expected to complement eClerx’s existing technology and global delivery infrastructure.

Kapil Jain, CEO and Managing Director of eClerx, said the deal was part of a broader strategy to expand capabilities and domain expertise through targeted acquisitions. RegEdge founder and CEO Harshad Pitkar said joining eClerx would allow the firm to extend its proprietary solutions and hands-on compliance approach to a larger client base.

eClerx operates across 17 countries with over 23,300 employees, serving Fortune 500 clients in financial services, telecom, retail, and other sectors. RegEdge’s team will now operate within that global network.
The move reflects growing demand among financial institutions for integrated solutions that combine regulatory advisory expertise with scalable technology and operational delivery.

title: eClerx acquires RegEdge to bolster regulatory and compliance capabilities
